title: Carl Linnaeus
summary: Carl Linnaeus (1707-1778), born at Stenbrohult in southern Sweden, studied medicine at Lund and Uppsala, and in 1735 published Systema Naturae, an inventory of the three kingdoms of nature. Professor at Uppsala from 1741, he sent students on expeditions to distant lands. He grouped species into genera, orders, classes and kingdoms, and gave each species a two-part name, genus plus epithet, as in Homo sapiens. Plant names in his Species Plantarum (1753) and animal names in Systema Naturae (1758) are still the official starting points of scientific naming.

uncertainty.note: Born 23 May 1707 (13 May Swedish calendar) at Råshult, Stenbrohult; died 10 January 1778 in Uppsala.
